tagline: Value-led - the cheapest names by composite valuation, a diversified top-8 on a fast 21-day cadence.

schedule.rationale: Paper sleeve on a 21-trading-day hold; pure-Valuation top-8 broad (hunt7 constrained config search, 2026-08-06; recorded walk-forward of the selection procedure 0.54x — hunt8). Replaces retired Prosodos in the 2026-11-10 go-live cohort per Bradley's 2026-08-07 order; paper rebalances continue on the 21-day grid until then.

backtest.forward_note: Backtested, NOT a forward projection. Recorded walk-forward validation (2026-08-06) realized 0.23x-0.54x of backtest CAGR across the selection procedures; the per-2yr regime range (5% to 64%, median 30%) is the honest spread.

caveats: SURVIVOR BIAS: survivors-only backtest universe, so CAGR is an UPPER BOUND. Of ~721 S&P names that left the index 2011-2026, only ~40 are genuine bankruptcies (the rest are M&A / ticker-changes, NOT losses) and are excluded from the panel. The failure-bias is bounded (momentum/quality screens avoid most pre-bankruptcy names) but real - not a survivorship-free track record.

UNIVERSE: broad scored panel (changed from PIT S&P membership 2026-08-06, Bradley's call). The panel contains NO delisted names, so this broad backtest is INCLUSION-BIASED upward -- the d10114a diagnostic measured roughly 10-15pts of such bias on the prior system. NO liquidity floor, by decision (Bradley, 2026-08-07): measured $5M/$10M median-dollar-volume floors cost 6-10pp CAGR (stage5_output/liquidity_floor_test.csv) and the current books already clear $5M; the sleeve ships floorless, which means small/illiquid names can and do enter the book.

Backtested 2011-2026, NOT a forward projection. Recorded walk-forward validation (expanding-window annual re-search, chained 2013-2026; hunt8 2026-08-06) realized 0.23x-0.54x of backtest CAGR across the selection procedures, with walk-forward drawdowns roughly 2x the in-sample drawdowns. An earlier '~0.4x' note was one prior internal measurement whose output was not preserved. Per-2yr regime CAGR ranged 10% to 72% (median 27%).

The 2021-2026 'OOS' column is a date SLICE of the same backtest, NOT a holdout: weights/N/hold were selected by full-window 2011-2026 grid search (5,720 configs), so 2021-2026 sat inside the selection objective. The recorded walk-forward figures above are the honest out-of-sample read.
TRUE daily mark-to-market - the -34% drawdown is the real intra-period low (COVID 2020), not a smoothed rebalance-spaced figure.
Top-8 concentration: high single-name risk. Held 168 distinct names over the backtest, rotating ~8 at a time.
Frictionless backtest: ignores ~342%/yr turnover cost, slippage, and short-term-gains tax. Net returns will be lower.
Current holdings = PAPER research book (signal-derived, never held at a broker) as of 2026-08-17; next rebalance projected 2026-09-07 (21-day hold).

SELECTION PROVENANCE: config chosen 2026-08-06 by a CONSTRAINED grid search (hunt7) -- admissibility ceilings on holdings overlap and sector concentration derived from the incumbent four-sleeve book -- then ranked by CAGR+Sharpe. Promoted (as Statera) 2026-08-07, Bradley's call, replacing retired Prosodos.

RECORDED WALK-FORWARD of the selection procedure (hunt8): 20.2% CAGR / 0.81 Sharpe / -41.4% maxDD chained 2013-2026 -- 0.54x the in-sample figure. The per-year selection log shows this specific config is the procedure's pick only in 2022-2023: the PROCEDURE is validated, not the config. Read expectations off the walk-forward row, not the backtest row.
No trading history: paper book from 2026-08-07. Prosodos's history is NOT this sleeve's history.
